id./param/scenario/cs/a_150_cs_080.pack|cs_: "Thank you, thank you! Darlings, it was nothing, really!
"Mahalo, mahalo! Whoever you people are, I can't thank you enough! The men who fell in the sea are all safe!
"But I can sure feed you enough! Tonight we're gonna have a luau to remember, and you're the guests of honour!
"Get ready to drink, dance and fill your belly with fish till you fall down! Come one, come all, to Lonalulu!
